$comment: OC-5D (P6): GET /api/service-history/me, the vehicle owner's service history. Pinned on BOTH sides of the wire: backend/tests/oc5d-owner-service-history-contract.test.js runs the mounted route against every row shape the schema has produced, and mobile/tests/garage-service-history-contract.test.ts holds the native renderer to it. RC1 returned select('*') rows, so the native screen read a `cost` key that never existed (F1, a TypeError on the first non-empty history), and the owner received other people's identifiers: after a sale, customer_name / customer_id name the PREVIOUS owner. The response is now built from this allow-list, never from the row.

money.$comment: Money is shown with its currency or not at all. mechanic_work_orders has no currency column, so on this schema every amount is recorded:false — a number without a currency is not displayable as money (and total_cost DEFAULT 0 cannot tell free from unrecorded).

failure.$comment: An unreadable ownership or work-order read is never reported as an empty history.
